doors.trait: Whatever you make leaves people fuller than it strictly had to, and that surplus is the signature. Your output feeds: conversation, cooking, company, all of it lands as sustenance rather than display. Feeding people is simply the shape your talent takes, in every medium.
doors.scene: They arrive wound tight, sit down at your kitchen table, and something loosens over the second hour. Soup helps, and so does the way you ask questions. By the door they are lighter and cannot name what happened. You can. It happens every time.
doors.outside: Nobody leaves your table the way they arrived, and word of that travels. You are the number people call on the bad night, the kitchen they route the heartbroken friend toward. It is a strange kind of fame, warm and unlisted, and you earned it a bowl at a time.
